concerns.text: The 'updatedAt' timestamp fields in UserNotificationPreference and DocumentLmsMetadata are initialized to LocalDateTime.now() inline but do not use JPA/Hibernate lifecycle annotations (like @UpdateTimestamp or @PreUpdate). Consequently, updates to existing entity rows will not automatically update 'updatedAt' unless explicitly set by the caller.

The custom constructor of UserNotificationPreference sets 'notifyOnDocumentUpdate' default fallback, but does not provide default values for 'createdAt' and 'updatedAt' inside the constructor, leaving them to inline initialization.
